title: Surface failed or indeterminate received outcomes when suppressing companion reminders
outcome: Suppressing an unnecessary companion test reminder still tells the agent about that item's current received failed or indeterminate registered run.
acceptance: A companion receipt with failed or indeterminate outcome names the registered outcome and record when its duplicate-test reminder is suppressed.
Passing and unavailable/dirty companion cases retain the correct reminder and no-credit behavior; no credit moves between roots.
